Your Majesty, I'm not sure what to make of this... device.

Nay, good sir! 'Tis a marvel of the modern age! With this device, we shall transform our entire empire into a realm of... of... (he consults the book again)...futuristic chic!

KING ARTHUR

Behold, my friends! Our empire shall be reborn in the image of... of... (he consults the book again)...the "Neo-Futurist Aesthetic"!

The people of the kingdom, initially perplexed by the sudden change, begin to adapt to the new aesthetic. They stroll through the streets, admiring the... the... (he consults the book again)..."Glowing Streetlights" and marveling at the... the... (he consults the book once more)..."Vaporwave-Infused Fountains".

KING ARTHUR
(to his advisor, LORD THOMAS)
Behold, my loyal subject! Our empire has never looked more... more... (he consults the book again)..."Futuristic"!

LORD THOMAS
(smirking)
Indeed, Your Majesty. The people are... are... (he consults the book once more)..."Vaporwave-Enthralled".

KING ARTHUR
(laughing)
Ah, good sir! You see, I have truly... truly... (he consults the book again)..."Embraced the Neo-Futurist Aesthetic"!
